take: Pittsburgh announced it placed right wing Andrew Mangiapane on injured reserve and put left wing Andrei Kuzmenko on non-roster status. Mangiapane, a fourth-line forward at 5:23 a night, has been out five games. In that stretch Teuvo Teravainen has taken his spot beside Bertuzzi and Frondell, and Roman Kantserov has moved up to 18:38 a night from 17:07. Kuzmenko had no goals and one assist in six games, though the Penguins controlled 51% of the 5-on-5 chances (expected goals share) with him on the ice.
